messages:
maria: Heads-up — deploy of entitlements_v2 migration started at 08:13 UTC. Seeing ~0.3% of users jump to admin-equivalent entitlements. Audit shows grants with KID=null and ttl_seconds = 0. Not good. INC-2026-134
ajay: ugh. Is this the migration that adds compact_role_map + default_role TTL?
maria: yes. migration SQL patch: 
```sql
ALTER TABLE user_entitlements ADD COLUMN ttl_seconds integer DEFAULT 0;
UPDATE user_entitlements SET role = 'default' WHERE role IS NULL;
```
we intended ttl_seconds to be NULLable and later set by backfill job, but deploy set default 0 which our permission-checker treats as "no expiry => permanent elevate"
taylor: deploy-bot shows rollout v3.2.1 succeeded on canary group then 50% then 100% at 08:12, 08:18, 08:30 UTC. Can we stop traffic to affected region?
maria: canary group was EU-only. Impact concentrated on EU customers. We paused further migrations at 08:41 via feature-flag.
leo: logs from auth-service: 
```
WARN auth: entitlement ttl parse failed for user=U12345, ttl_seconds=0, kid=null
ERROR policy-eval: grant allowed for resource=production/admin for user=U12345 via policy ent_v2_fallback
```
ajay: that KID=null is suspicious — KMS rotation finished last night (key id=rw-key-2026-03). Did the migration accidentally strip kms kid when serializing the entitlement blob?
maria: I grep'd the migration: it wrote JSON blob using `to_jsonb(row)` which drops the key_id metadata we stored in separate column before. So yes — KID column stayed but the serialized blob was missing. Policy engine prioritizes blob.kid over column.kid if present, and blob.kid=null => fallback path grants. Bad ordering.
taylor: action plan: 1) revert migration commit on DB schema to stop new writes to ent_v2 (rolled feature flag already), 2) run backfill to repopulate blob.kid from column.kid for all rows, 3) reconcile audit logs + revoke any unexpected grants, 4) postmortem. Agree?
leo: +1. I can run a dry backfill on staging then run production backfill with streaming txn. Backfill script: 
```bash
psql -c "UPDATE user_entitlements SET blob = jsonb_set(blob, '{kid}', to_jsonb(kid::text)) WHERE blob->>'kid' IS NULL;"
```
maria: make sure to add safety checks. We'll only update rows where ttl_seconds = 0 and role IN ('admin','maintainer') to limit scope.
ajay: I'll open a short-lived playbook and coordinate with oncall. Also rotate the fallback rule so blob.kid null doesn't mean grant — change evaluator to fallback-deny until backfill completes. Can we ship that as a hotfix?
taylor: yes, evaluator change is small: default to deny on missing kid unless explicit allow-from-column present. I'll push hotfix -> canary in 15m.
leo: once hotfix is live we should re-run the audit query: 
```sql
SELECT user_id, role, kid FROM user_entitlements WHERE blob->>'kid' IS NULL AND role IN ('admin','maintainer');
```
and revoke any ephemeral tokens issued after 08:12 UTC.
maria: I've created INC-2026-134 in PagerDuty and notified security@ and legal for potential compliance reachouts. tagging: @ajay @taylor @leo.
deploy-bot: rollback job queued: rollback migration ent_v2 -> awaiting manual approval. (react :eyes:)
ajay: approving rollback now. Also add metric alert for any user_entitlements with ttl_seconds = 0 and blob->>'kid' IS NULL moving forward.
taylor: hotfix pushed to canary at 09:05 UTC. No new grants observed in 10m window.
leo: starting prod backfill at 09:20 with batch size 5000; ETA ~30m. Monitoring audit-index for any new unexpected grants.
maria: thanks team. After backfill completes we should run full audit reconciliation against `audit_log` to identify elevated-grant events between 08:12-09:20 and revoke. Postmortem draft assigned to me.
ajay: filing follow-ups: add unit test for jsonb_set usage, add migration preflight to test blob integrity, KMS rotation checklist update.
taylor: marking incident resolved once backfill + reconciliation done. keep updates here. :thumbsup:
